title: Zucchini and Potato Bake
description: This zucchini and potato recipe takes lightly seasoned potatoes, zucchini, and red bell pepper and bakes them all together for an easy side dish.
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks
2 medium zucchini, quartered and cut into large pieces
1 medium red bell pepper, seeded and chopped
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Toss together potatoes, zucchini, red bell pepper, bread crumbs, olive oil, and garlic in a medium baking pan. Season with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender and lightly brown, about 1 hour.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make a delicious vegetable side dish. Fresh zucchini, potatoes, bell peppers and garlic are lightly tossed in olive oil, seasonings and breadcrumbs. Bake for an hour and you've got a versatile dish that's warm, toasty, and especially delicious with roasted chicken or fish.
